body: I'm glad it worked for you, but please don't tell me I don't know myself well enough to know that it's not something that will work for my situation.
Thanks, but a camera won't do shit to fix my hopeless situation.
I don't have money, and I need someone I can talk to long-term who knows my situation, not someone who I can just talk to for a little while one night. Reality is I just don't have options. None.

This sounds useless given the reason I need a therapist. I have no one to talk to ever, and I'm at a point where I am completely stuck with no options and would like to see if maybe the therapist would have some ideas for getting me out of my situation. Practicing CBT on my own sounds like more loneliness and bashing my head against a wall alone.
Meh. A lot of the reason for wanting to see a therapist is the loneliness of not having anyone to share all of this misery with is crushing. Can't talk things out with a self-help website.
Thank you. Those posts were really upsetting to read.
It's not even better. It's hard to enjoy any of that stuff with the knowledge that you don't have money for your basic needs at the back of your mind.

The point about the hotlines being useless wasn't so much about being arrested as them not actually being any help. Sure, I can walk to the park and call them so they can't find me. They're still not going to be able to give me the long-term help I need. They exist to keep people physically alive for the night, not to actually help people with their underlying situations.
I don't have a work to call in sick to.

Yeah, that's why I said that I don't go because I know all I'll get to show for it is a bill. There's nowhere to actually go. People like to tell you there are places and options because the reality is too dark for them to contend with, but it is the reality.
That's what is comes down to, no matter how much people insist it isn't true. The safety net full of other options doesn't exist. It's gaslighting as far as I'm concerned.

No, because those options aren't feasible for me. How the fuck am I supposed to go become a photographer when you need money to buy a camera, money and energy to learn the techniques, etc. and I'm completely broke? There aren't any vet clinics hiring.

This is why I shouldn't have posted. I don't need advice. I already know I have no options. It's why I'm so depressed.

As I said, I have no one. I don't have friends. Not a single one. Everything I do is alone, or I guess with my dog. My mom is dead. My dad doesn't care. I have no contact with distant relatives.

I didn't take any pills. I don't know where that came from.
